{{Quote|We are a ''volunteer militia'', which means the majority of our fighters do not ''consider'' themselves military. They fight for a ''cause'', not a flag.|Chancellor Mon Mothma|<ref name="Star Wars 2020 44">[[Star Wars (2020) 44|''Star Wars'' (2020) 44]]</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Army''', also known as the '''rebel army''', was a [[Alliance Military|military]] branch containing the [[Army|ground forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Ranking members of the Rebel army could be identified by a [[Rebel command insignia|pips]] with [[Color|green]] markings. Eventually, it was replaced by the [[New Republic army]].

==Description==
===Organization===
[[File:Rebel_Troopers_Upgrade_Expansion_art.png|thumb|right|200px|A Gran and Ishi Tib Rebel trooper.]]
The rebel army was composed of a variety of different soldiers and [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. The Imperial occupations of many species' [[homeworld]]s resulted in an abundance of warriors native to those worlds to enlist in the rebel army. Such warriors included [[Drabatan Saboteur]]s, [[Iakaru Warrior]]s, [[Wookiee warrior]]s, and [[Gigoran Fighter]]s.<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref> The [[rebel trooper]] was one of the standard types of [[trooper]] used by the army.<ref name="GD" />

The rebel army maintained several elite troopers for their operations. Such troopers included the [[Ithorian Infiltrator]], the [[Bufopel Protector]], the Rebel pathfinder, the [[Rebel Commando]]<ref name="Commander" /> the [[Rebel Honor Guard]]<ref name="GD" /> and the marines from the [[Marine Corps]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The rebel army maintained several troopers that specialized in a specific environment, such as the [[Cold-weather Soldier]] and the [[Desert Soldier]].<ref name="Commander" /> Members of "Fisheye Company" were specialized to fight in [[Water|aquatic]] environments.<ref name="Twilight">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>

The army of the Alliance was composed of a wide array of specialized soldiers that specialized in certain weapons, missions, or tactics. For heavy ordinances, the Alliance's army employed the [[Heavy Soldier]], the [[Cold-weather Heavy Soldier]], the [[Heavy Desert Soldier]], the [[Rebel Vanguard]],<ref name="Commander" /> the Quarren Heavy Gunner, the [[Sullustan Demolition]],<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''</ref> and the [[Special-weapons flamethrower]].<ref name="Rebel Files" /> The army also utilized [[jetpack]]-equipped soldiers such as the [[Jetpack Trooper]], the [[Arctic Jetpack Trooper]], the [[Desert Jetpack Trooper]], the [[Forest Jetpack Trooper]],<ref name="Commander" /> the [[Ishi Tib Jetpack Trooper]],<ref name="Battlefront" /> and the [[rocket-jumper]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>

The army also made use of several types of [[sniper]]-equipped troopers, including the [[Rebel Marksman]],<ref name="GD" /> the [[Rodian Sniper]],<ref name="Battlefront" /> and the [[Sullustan Recon Sharpshooter]]. The rebel army also had mounted troopers, which consisted of the [[Bantha Rider]] and the [[Tauntaun Rider]].<ref name="Commander" /> [[Alliance gunner]]s maintained and used heavy weaponry.<ref name="Episode V" /> To bolster their forces, the army's mercenaries consisted of [[Dowutin Hunter]]s, [[Fathier Rider]]s, [[Gamorrean Warrior]]s, [[Luggabeast Munitioneer]]s, [[Tognath Marksmen]], and [[Twi'lek Incinerator]]s.<ref name="Commander" /> [[Combat engineer]]s were also used by the rebel army, and specialized in [[engineer]]ing operations on the battlefield.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===Divisions===
[[File:Shield_Generator_Assault_2017_Q1_Tournament_Kit.png|thumb|left|250px|A grouping of the Special Forces Trackers Unit, a formation of commandos active under the Alliance Army and commonly known as the "Pathfinders"]]
The [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]] branch was organized under the Alliance Army,<ref name="CL" /> and so units such as the [[Marine Corps]], the [[Yavin 4 Special Forces division]] and [[4th SpecForce Regiment]] were placed under it.<ref name="UVG" /> [[Battalion]]s were also within the Alliance Army, an example being a [[Unidentified rebel battalion|rebel battalion]] dispatched to [[Vrogas Vas]].<ref name="Vader Down">[[Vader Down 1|''Vader Down'' 1]]</ref> The Alliance Army consisted of hundreds of [[battle group]]s that could be organized as [[Company|companies]]. Examples of Alliance companies were the [[61st Mobile Infantry|61st Mobile Infantry "Twilight Company"]], the [[Sixty-Eighth Infantry]] "Fisheye Company", "[[Bitter Pill Company]],"<ref name="Twilight" /> and a [[Vrogas Vas company|company]] that defended [[Vrogas Vas]].<ref name="Vader Down" />

Strike teams such as the [[Endor strike team]] were also deployed.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Other units included the [[Twenty-First]], the [[Thirty-Second Infantry]] "Bleeding Roughnecks",<ref name="Twilight" /> the [[32nd Commando Unit]], the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit]], the [[Stardust unit]], the [[Vapetailers unit]], and the [[Shrikes]] recon unit.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> The [[Tatooine rebel cell]] was a large Alliance Army group as well.<ref name="Commander" />

Smaller units were also active, such as [[Red Platoon]],<ref name="Vader 43">[[Darth Vader (2020) 43|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 43]]</ref> [[second platoon]],<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (2015) 13|''Star Wars'' (2015) 13]]</ref> [[Ette Shi'lou's platoon|Ette Shi'lou's marine platoon]],<ref name="Lead Example" /> [[Taidu Sefla's SpecForces platoon]],<ref name="Heroes">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Heroes of Rogue One}}</ref> as well as [[squad]]s like [[Delta Squad (Vrogas Vas)|Delta Squad]],<ref name="SW13" /> [[Extraction Team Bravo]],<ref name="UVG" /> [[M.A.R. Corps]],<ref name="Vader 2020 42">[[Darth Vader (2020) 42|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 42]]</ref> and squads led by [[Ajax's squad|Ajax]], [[Carver's squad|Carver]], [[Charmer's squad|Charmer's]], [[Fektrin's squad|Fektrin]], [[Namir's squad|Namir]], [[Twitch's squad|Twitch]], and [[Zab's squad|Zab]].<ref name="Twilight" />

===Training===
{{Quote|Probably a third of the personnel were Imperial cadets before defecting. Maybe another third of us—some of us cadets, too—went through Alliance Special Forces training. Four months of misery, but they were the most important ones of my life. You want to learn how to use an antique slugthrower, disable a proximity mine, or rappel off a ray shield, I recommend it.|Kryndal, to Hazram Namir|<ref name="Twilight" />}}
Theoretically, all Rebel soldiers were trained the same way, using a field guide known as the ''[[White Book]]''. According to the ''White Book'', training was to be divided into three to four phases; the first two were identical for every soldier, while the third had two types, one for ground forces and another for space forces. The fourth phase was used to train special forces.<ref name="Twilight" />

In reality, only base troops actually underwent a formal training as suggested by the ''White Book''. In Twilight Company, for example, training consisted of little more than being shown how to use a blaster. Alliance Special Forces training taught a number of skills, including using antique [[slugthrower]]s, disarming [[proximity mine]]s, and rappelling off of [[ray shield]]s. According to [[Kryndal]], about a third of the personnel at [[Echo Base]] had undergone Special Forces training.<ref name="Twilight" />

===Equipment===
====Vehicles====
The vehicles of the rebel army originated from varied sources. In addition to their own vehicles, the rebel army obtained several that dated back to the [[Clone Wars]] to both the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the army also supplemented its forces with stolen Imperial vehicles such as the [[All Terrain Anti Aircraft]], [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|All Terrain Armored Transport]], the [[All Terrain Scout Transport]], the [[All Terrain Defense Turret]], and the [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]]. Clone Wars-era vehicles included the Republic's [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]], the [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport]], the [[All Terrain Attack Pod]], [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]],<ref name="Knights of Fate">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref> and the Confederacy's [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tank]], [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tank]], the [[Multi-Troop Transport]] and the [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon]].<ref name="Commander" />

[[File:AA5SpeederTruck-SWQ05.png|thumb|right|300px|The A-A5 Speeder Truck, a vehicle retrofitted by the Alliance for war against the Empire]]
In addition, the Clone Wars-era and Imperial vehicles were supplemented by the army's [[Arrow-23 landspeeder|Arrow-23]], [[Heavy Tracker]], [[Freerunner]], [[Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle]],<ref name="Rebel Files" /> [[Juggernaut (Rebel Alliance)|Juggernaut]], [[Keelkana-class attack submersible]],<ref name="Starships and Speeders">''[[Starships and Speeders]]''</ref> [[A-A5 Speeder Truck]], [[T2-B Repulsor Tank]], [[Enhanced T2-B Repulsor Tank]],<ref name="Commander" /> [[MLC-3 light tank]], the [[Endor Forest Ranger]], the [[74-Z speeder bike]],<ref name="GD" /> [[X-34 landspeeder]],<ref name="Battlefront II" /> T-47 airspeeder,<ref name="Episode V" /> and the [[V-4X-D ski speeder]].<ref name="Commander" />

In addition, the rebel army also heavily modified vehicles to better suit their purposes. Several of these modified vehicles included the [[Elite AT-TE]], the [[Anti-Vehicle Skiff]], the [[Cold-weather Hailfire Droid]], and the [[Enhanced AT-AP Walker]].<ref name="Commander" /> Also in its arsenal, the army utilized stationary [[artillery]] pieces. Such weapons included the [[1.4 FD P-Tower]], the [[DF.9 anti-infantry battery|DF.9 turret placement]],<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> the [[V-232 artillery emplacement]], the [[V-120 artillery emplacement]],<ref name="Storms of Crait">[[The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait 1|''The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait'' 1]]</ref> and the [[v-150 Planet Defender]].<ref name="Ultimate" /> Rumor held that almost the entire production run of the [[Versatile-Athletic Walker]] was donated to the Alliance by [[Baktoid Industrial Systems]] engineers, who wanted to show their appreciation to the Alliance for being granted asylum from the Empire.<ref name="Forged in Battle">''[[Forged in Battle]]''</ref>

====Weapons and utilities====
The rebel army was well equipped with a variety of infantry weapons such as [[blaster rifle]]s, which included the [[A280 blaster rifle]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> the [[A280C blaster rifle]],<ref name="Episode V" /> the [[A300 blaster rifle|A-300 blaster rifle]], the [[A280-CFE convertible heavy blaster pistol|A280-CFE blaster]], the [[A310 rifle]], the [[DH-17 blaster rifle]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> the [[E-5C heavy blaster rifle|E-5C]], and at times the stolen [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]].<ref name="Battlefront II" /> Members of the rebel army also used the [[DH-17 blaster pistol]],<ref name="Episode V" /> the [[A-180 blaster|A180 pistol]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle]],<ref name="SW13" /> the [["Roba" M-45 repeating ion blaster]],<ref name="UVG" /> the [[Vulk TAU-6-23 "Blastmill" rotary blaster cannon]], the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]],<ref name="Commander" /> and the [[Mark II EWHB-10]].<ref name="Episode V" />

For heavy ordnance, the rebel army was equipped with the [[PLX-1]],<ref name="Twilight" /> the [[RPS-6 rocket launcher]],<ref name="An Inside Man">{{Rebels|An Inside Man}}</ref> the [[HH-12 rocket launcher]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> and the [[Smart Rocket]].<ref name="Battlefront" /> The Alliance had rank insignia, though they were rarely seen in smaller cells or units such as mobile infantry companies.<ref name="Twilight" />

==History==
===Background===
{{Quote|If you had an army, what would you do with it?|Senator Mon Mothma, to Saw Gerrera|<ref name="MoF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref>}}
Around [[19 BBY]],<ref name="19Date">{{MOFdate|68}}</ref> at the first meeting between [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa]], and the [[Partisans|Partisan]] leader [[Saw Gerrera]] as a triumvirate, the three informally established the beginnings of their revolutionary alliance. Gerrera promised to bring together the roots of a rebel army that would oppose the reigning [[Galactic Empire]], marking himself as their blooming alliance's military heart, whereas Organa and Mothma would establish themselves as its ideological and political centers, respectively.<ref name="MoF" />

===Formation===
[[File:RebelJog-Andor.png|thumb|left|300px|The makings and early form of the rebel army could be found on Yavin 4.]]
The Alliance Army<ref name="Rebel Files" /> was the ground forces<ref name="beware" /> of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which had been founded by Mothma in [[2 BBY]] to organize the various rebel cells and factions scattered across [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> Ahead of the Alliance's official formation, as the group became increasingly formalized, the makings of the Alliance Army could be found on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]],<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> where Mothma and fellow rebel organizer [[Bail Prestor Organa]] intended to base their organized revolution. Mothma's cousin [[Vel Sartha]] helped organize the new recruits<ref name="Welcome">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> of the growing army.<ref name="Messenger" /> With the official formation of the Alliance,<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> the formalized Alliance Army came into being, with [[rebel trooper]]s as its identified [[infantry]] [[soldier]]s.<ref name="ScenetoStats">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/scene-to-stats-rebel-troopers|text=Scene to Stats: Rebel Troopers}}</ref> As the years had passed, however, Gerrera's extreme tactics had created friction with Mothma.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

All the same, however, the [[Battle of Atollon]] would prove to the Alliance that it was not yet ready for open war,<ref name="In the Name">{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}}</ref> leading to an era of surgical strikes instead of focusing on wide scale conflict.<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="RO1Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which include [[Operation Fracture]], to [[1 BBY]].</ref> [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] assigned various rebel ground units, including a platoon of [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|Special Forces]] marines led by [[Lieutenant]] [[Taidu Sefla]] and the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]], to support [[Operation Fracture]] depending on what happened on [[Jedha]].<ref name="Rebel Dossier" /> Members of the Special Forces' [[Extraction Team Bravo]] also rescued [[Jyn Erso]] from the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[prison]] on [[Wobani]].<ref name="UVG" /> Shortly later, rebel ground forces raced to the planet [[Scarif]] under Erso as the "[[Rogue One]]" unit to steal the [[Death Star plans]]. In the ensuing [[Battle of Scarif]], the Alliance marshalled the rest of its forces, reinforcing Rogue One on the ground and with air support,<ref name="Rogue One" /> in what became its first major victory against the Empire. Shortly after that, [[rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] in the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

===In action===
{{Quote|Maybe I'm crazy, but it feels like we're on the verge of something real. We can make it to Coruscant. The Empire wouldn't be fighting so hard if it weren't afraid.|Kryndal, soldier of Alliance Special Forces|<ref name="Twilight">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>}}
[[File:VaderDeadMen-VaderDown1.png|thumb|right|300px|An entire force of Alliance soldiers and heavy vehicles attempted to confront Darth Vader on Vrogas Vas, to no avail.]]
Forces of the Alliance Army rallied to the planet [[Vrogas Vas]] in an [[Battle of Vrogas Vas|attempt to capture or kill]] the Imperial enforcer and [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who crashed onto the surface after a collision with Skywalker. Vader took on members of the [[Vrogas Vas company]]. Vrogas Vas-based rebel forces were reinforced by another [[Unidentified rebel battalion|battalion]] during the battle.<ref name="Vader Down">[[Vader Down 1|''Vader Down'' 1]]</ref> The [[second platoon]] and [[Delta Squad (Vrogas Vas)|Delta Squad]] engaged Vader.<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (2015) 13|''Star Wars'' (2015) 13]]</ref> With rebel forces pushed into a retreat in the end,<ref name="Vader 15">[[Darth Vader (2015) 15|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 15]]</ref> the battle resulted in an Imperial victory.<ref name="Battles that Changed">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

At some point, the [[uprising on Molos]] was waged by the newly formed [[Molos army]], who would fight as rebel forces in the ensuing [[Battle of Molopolis]].<ref name="Lead Example">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref> A rebel platoon, whose number included a [[Unidentified rebel trooper (convoy ambush)|rebel trooper]] who felt a tension in the air, waited for [[Standard week|weeks]] before launching an [[ambush on an Imperial supply convoy]]. The battle was on the verge of ending with a victory for the Alliance until Vader revealed himself, much to the horror of the rebels.<ref name="WelcometoLegion">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/welcome-to-legion|text=Welcome to Legion}}</ref>

[[File:JackGregory-UnivitedGuests.png|thumb|left|300px|Rebel soldiers rally against the Imperial attack on Echo Base.]]
Rebel ground forces including the [[61st Mobile Infantry]] or "Twilight Company"<ref name="Twilight" /> saw action against General [[Maximilian Veers]]' elite [[Blizzard Force]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]]. Rebel infantry, artillery, and [[T-47 airspeeder|snowspeeders]] fought in the defense of [[Echo Base]] but were overwhelmed by Blizzard Force's [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]].<ref name="Episode V" /> Twilight Company also saw action during several campaigns of the [[Galactic Civil War]] including the [[Mid Rim Retreat]], [[Operation Ringbreaker]], and the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]]. During the Mid Rim Retreat, the [[Bitter Pill Company]], [[Twenty-First]] company, and the aquatic [[Sixty-Eighth Infantry]] were deployed in various diversionary actions against the [[Imperial Army]].<ref name="Twilight" />

===Battle of Endor===
{{Quote|If this mission fails, then the Rebellion must go on. The rebel fleet, the rebel army— they'll be gone. But the rebel spirit will still exist.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="beware" />}}
[[File:Endor_trooper_shield.png|thumb|right|250px|Rebel soldiers deploy a shield generator while combating an AT-ST on Endor.]]
During the [[Battle of Endor]], General [[Han Solo]] led a [[Endor strike team|strike team]] to [[Endor]] to disable the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star's]] [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]]. Solo's strike team forged an alliance with local [[Ewok]] tribes and succeeded in storming the Imperial base and destroying the shield generator. This turned the tide of the battle against the Empire, leading to the death of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The morning after the Battle of Endor, General Solo led the Pathfinders on an [[Assault on an Imperial outpost|attack]] against an [[Imperial outpost (Endor)|Imperial outpost]] on the far side of Endor. Though the Pathfinders and their Ewok allies eliminated the Imperial holdout, Solo warned that the war was far from over.<ref name="SE 1" />

===Wretch of Tayron===
Solo later led the Pathfinders on a [[Raid at the Wretch of Tayron|raid]] against an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] black site at the [[Wretch of Tayron]]. As a result of the raid, the Alliance obtained intelligence about the Emperor's posthumous [[Operation: Cinder]].<ref name="SE 3">[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]]</ref>

===Legacy===
In the months following the Battle of Endor, the Rebel army transitioned into the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic army|army]] as the Alliance took steps to restore the Republic.<ref name="Aftermath" />
